resources.title: Focus groups and individual interviews: children' embodied story experiences (transcripts)

paragraphs: Focus groups and individual interviews: children' embodied story experiences (transcripts)
Restricted access: the files of this record are restricted. You may request access to the files in this upload, provided that you fulfil the conditions below.

This dataset contains 2 transcripts (.docx) of creative focus groups and 6 transcripts (.docx) of creative individual interviews, involving a total of 19 children aged 9 to 11 years and conducted in the Czech Republic from March 2020 to October 2020.
The data was collected by the research group 'Integrating Text & Literacy Research', funded by Charles University (PRIMUS/20/HUM/005).
All transcripts have been anonymised to protect participant identities in accordance with GDPR and the research group's ethical guidelines.
